title: MASTER-IOCS.json schema (additive v2)
description: Schema for MASTER-IOCS.json produced by master_iocs_aggregator (W-203). Additive over the legacy iocs-only shape.

schema_version.description: Version tag for this schema; legacy MASTER-IOCS.json files may omit it (loader stays back-compatible).

case_id.description: Operator-scoped case identifier; uppercase alphanumerics with underscore and hyphen, leading alphanumeric.

generated_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this MASTER-IOCS.json was written.

generator_id.description: Identifier for the writer module plus the git SHA in the form module@sha.

corpus_root_id.description: HMAC-truncated identifier for the corpus mount root; replaces leaking the absolute filesystem path.

iocs.description: Discriminator-routed list of IOC records consumed by the case loader.

kind.description: Discriminator field naming the IOC variant; loader routes on this.

case_id.description: Same operator-scoped case identifier as the top-level case_id.

value.description: Stringified IOC value for legacy kinds; absent on process_tree_event.

confidence.description: Confidence band for the indicator; legacy kinds use string enum, process_tree_event uses numeric.

mitre.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique identifier in T#### or T####.### form.

host.description: Per-host bucket name from which the indicator was extracted; required on process_tree_event.

pid.description: Process identifier from the memory snapshot for process_tree_event rows.

parent_pid.description: Parent process identifier from the memory snapshot for process_tree_event rows.

name.description: Process image basename as observed by the volatility pslist walker.

image_path_normalized.description: Lowercased SystemRoot-expanded forward-slash path; null when upstream did not emit a path.

image_sha256.description: Lowercase 64-char hex SHA-256 of the on-disk image binary; null when source did not expose it.

image_hash_source.description: Tag describing how image_sha256 was resolved or that the path-string fallback was used.

command_line_redacted.description: Redactor output for the process command line; null when upstream did not surface a command line.

command_line_sha256.description: Lowercase 64-char hex SHA-256 over the original unredacted command line; evidence-chain helper only.

first_seen_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp from the source finding when the process tree row was first observed.

source_artifact.description: Corpus-relative path to the per-host report.json that produced this row; never an absolute path.

source_finding_index.description: Zero-based index of the original Finding within the per-host findings array.

evidence_kind.description: Sub-kind of the process tree finding as classified by the source emitter.

evidence_reason.description: Short free-text reason copied from the source finding when it carried one; redacted.

threads.description: Thread count parsed from the source evidence line; zero when not surfaced.

wow64.description: Whether the process executes under WOW64 according to the source evidence line.

redacted.description: True when at least one credential pattern was redacted from this row by redact_finding.

redactor_version.description: Version tag for the redactor that processed this row.

connection_state.description: TCP connection state label for ip rows.

source_path.description: Legacy source-path field for non-process-tree kinds.

host_count.description: Number of hosts observing this indicator for legacy kinds.

filename_hint.description: Filename hint preserved for hash kinds.

persistence_type.description: Persistence subtype label for registry kinds.

provenance.description: Optional WZ-019 provenance triple block; structural shape preserved for legacy kinds.

process_tree_findings_skipped.description: Per-host skip rows emitted when a report.json failed to parse or had no input.

host.description: Per-host bucket name whose report.json was skipped.

source_artifact.description: Corpus-relative path to the per-host report.json that was skipped.

reason_class.description: Python exception class name or sentinel describing the skip cause.

reason_detail.description: Truncated reason detail; redacted and capped before write.
